title: A Cover for the Debt
author: Ansel Eriksen
blurb: Theo Dravenmoor, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
